server.title: Conductor Relay MCP

headers.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated Conductor Relay agent tools. Use the format: Bearer YOUR_CR_AGENT_KEY. Public tools do not require a key.
headers.name: Authorization

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.certification_lane: External v0 design: customer SOW to bounded work package decomposition, external validation, evidence packages, and future capability certification; exchange integration deferred until vetted.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.policy: Managed internal DB-CPTM closed-economy v0; no external withdrawal, no bridge, no cash-out, no external token value.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.sdk_marketplace: Marketplace / SKU lane: neutral exchange of SDK/service/artifact packages; artifact delivery is live for marketplace orders (provider upload, server verification, buyer download, accept/reject, settlement/refund).
